articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Text, Image, Audio, and Video
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, which features deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can process and cross-reference video, audio, images, and text in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on complex multi-step reasoning tasks compared to GPT-4o, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model is available via API with a new tiered pricing structure aimed at enterprise adoption.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Discovery Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which set new records on ScienceBench and MathOdyssey, demonstrating an ability to generate novel hypotheses in materials science that were subsequently validated in the lab. The model leverages a new architecture combining mixture-of-experts with chain-of-thought verification layers, enabling more rigorous self-consistency in long-form scientific reasoning.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered pilot deployment at select BMW manufacturing plants and Amazon fulfillment centers for bin-picking, parts transport, and light assembly tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for natural language task instruction. Early reports suggest the robots achieve roughly 85% of human worker throughput on targeted repetitive tasks.

articles.title: Figure AI and Microsoft Partner on Foundation Models for General-Purpose Humanoid Control
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a deep partnership with Microsoft to co-develop large-scale foundation models specifically trained for humanoid robot control, combining sim-to-real transfer learning with massive real-world teleoperation datasets. The collaboration aims to create a general-purpose locomotion and manipulation stack that can be fine-tuned across different robot morphologies. Initial demos showed a Figure 03 robot autonomously navigating a cluttered construction site and performing tool use.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI v3 with Formal Verification Guarantees for Safety-Critical Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional AI v3, which integrates formal verification methods to provide mathematical guarantees that model outputs stay within defined safety boundaries for specific deployment domains. The approach uses a combination of constrained decoding and proof-carrying responses in domains like medical advice and legal analysis. This marks a significant step toward AI systems that can be certified for use in regulated industries.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N1.4 process node using next-generation gate-all-around transistors at its Kaohsiung fab, with first customers including NVIDIA and Apple. The node delivers a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction compared to N2, which is critical for scaling AI training and inference chips beyond current thermal limits. NVIDIA's next-generation Blackwell Ultra GPUs are expected to be among the first AI accelerators fabricated on this process.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta for their general-purpose AI systems classified as systemic risk. Companies are required to demonstrate red-teaming procedures, compute reporting, and downstream risk assessments. The audits are being closely watched as a template for AI governance worldwide and have already prompted several providers to publish detailed model cards and safety evaluations.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil New Electric Atlas with 4-Hour Runtime and Enhanced Autonomous Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, revealed a major update to its electric Atlas humanoid platform featuring a redesigned battery system that extends operational runtime to over four hours under load and a new autonomous navigation stack built on 3D Gaussian splatting for real-time scene understanding. The updated Atlas completed a public demo navigating a multi-story construction site, climbing stairs, and carrying 30 kg payloads. Hyundai plans to deploy units in its Ulsan shipyard by Q1 2027.
